status: Read-only growth diagnosis completed; no product changes or codec expansion

evidence.interpretation: Per-artifact manifests retain their own ordered block references. All 50 roots and 1130 blobs verify. Identical manifest copies occupy only 26,892 B, so shared manifest indirection would address a small fraction of current growth and add another lifetime relationship.

scope.method: Copied frozen engine database/WAL into private temporary directories, opened SDK only there, normalized run1 with explicit state compression/compaction and compacted run2 copy for fragmentation measurement. Original runtime and frozen files unchanged; no browser/provider or plugin database access.

conclusion: Most growth is retained new entity/event history, especially identity/action data. State compression and Observation structural sharing remained correct. No orphan objects/evidence or old Observation mutation was found. Restart introduced new document/control instances; it did not duplicate persisted objects with identical session/hash.

state.integrity: All states decoded with SQL owner, exact byte-length and SHA validation; old hashes unchanged. No plain-state regression.

observation.restart: First new frame has a new documentId; all 285 comparable prior controls changed localId and instanceId. The next same-document frame shares 836 objects, reusing 88 old-run objects and inserting 748. A later navigation seeds another 403 objects. Those two promotions account for 1151/1181 new objects; the remaining 30 are content changes across steady/action frames. No persisted object table was reset.

redundantFacts.identity: Identity lastControl grows 981,480 B and occurrences 833,348 B. All complete lastControl and occurrences fields are distinct; 142 old identities append occurrences (+370,990 B). Signature values repeat (433 unique across 1142 records, 255,367 exact-duplicate logical bytes), but matching signatures alone cannot justify merging identities.
redundantFacts.action: New action rows contribute 1,913,521 B. Preconditions have only 11 exact unique values across 4789 rows (1,153,448 duplicate logical bytes); basis has 274 unique values across 4787 rows (587,733 duplicate logical bytes). Reusable exact values could eventually be immutable shared payloads, but action IDs, observation/control ownership and order must remain intact.
redundantFacts.events: New events add 973,941 B, led by exploration.group_detected 364,904 B. action.completed stores the same complete attempt facts and observation.diff stores attempt.diff again. Retaining both event and entity history is current behavior, not an orphan leak.
redundantFacts.cacheOrManifest: No new persisted state/Observation cache was introduced. Cache-like intervention-snapshot history adds 161,764 B; evidence manifests add 300,192 B. These are retained per-root facts/reference lists, not unbounded in-memory cache spill.

fragmentation.interpretation: Unused space within B-tree/overflow pages is not all reclaimable. A real VACUUM of the disposable run2 copy recovers 720,896 B (7.35% of the growth); 9,084,928 B additional compacted data remains versus normalized run1. Repeated maintenance cannot solve new-history growth.

nextSteps.action: Proceed with the identified recovery-selection fix and measure added bytes per successful exploration after it. Keep current storage code frozen during that work.
nextSteps.benefit: Avoids prioritizing a small fragmentation cleanup over the observed recovery blocker.
nextSteps.constraint: Do not drop required observations, immutable historical roots, unknown/executing state or evidence to force size targets.

nextSteps.action: Later benchmark self-contained compression of selected large identity/group rows, preserving existing ID/session binding and mutable-row behavior.
nextSteps.cost: Identity rows are written/read much more often than the nine large states. A 2,549,330 B potential payload reduction for 571 identity rows is only a gzip3+300-byte-envelope size estimate; no speed or memory improvement is established. Needs isolated actual SQLite CPU/read/update tests and schema compatibility review before implementation.

nextSteps.action: Evaluate immutable sharing of exact action preconditions/basis, without merging action or identity records.
nextSteps.benefit: Exact duplicate values total about 1.74 MB logical bytes in run2.
nextSteps.cost: Adds many shared references and GC roots, owner/session checks and decode batching. More complex than self-contained state compression; defer until profiling proves acceptable write/read cost.

nextSteps.action: Keep compaction explicit and idle-only; defer manifest interning.
nextSteps.benefit: At most 720,896 B recovered now by VACUUM; exact duplicate artifact manifest payload is only 26,892 B.
nextSteps.cost: Compaction performs whole-database I/O and manifest sharing adds lifecycle complexity.

limitations: Only the two authorized frozen engine/evidence snapshots were analyzed. Plugin database and runner/log growth were not opened or attributed, so the reported 30,368,331 B overall total is not fully decomposed here.
No browser/provider operation or original/frozen database write occurred. Copy-only normalization and VACUUM are diagnostic measurements, not maintenance of the actual experiment.
Compression estimates are bytes only. No end-to-end timing, model latency, capture cost or performance benefit is claimed.
